title: Hip Pocket v1 (plain)
comment: A pitch bend, CC1, and CC64 demo, 16 bars of funk at 98 BPM in E Dorian. Bars 1-8 are a 16th-note groove on Em7 | A9 under a saw lead riffing with scoops, bends into accents, glides, a fall, and a doit. Bars 9-12 break down to Cmaj9 Bm11 Am9 B7sus4 B7, with the electric piano under the sustain pedal and the lead holding long notes with delayed vibrato. Bars 13-16 bring the groove back and end on a long fall. This is the plain version: the same notes without automation, and electric piano notes in the breakdown held to each chord change instead of pedaled.
